REPORTEDLY, A TRACTOR TRAILER/TANKER STRUCK ANOTHER TRUCK IN A PARKING LOT AT THE INCIDENT LOCATION. THE ACCIDENT RESULTED IN A BREACH IN THE TANKER AND A RELEASE OF AN UNKNOWN PETROLEUM PRODUCT (PRODUCT IS BELIEVED TO BE A TRANSMIX OF CRANK CASE OIL, DIESEL, ETC). THE PETROLEUM PRODUCT SPILLED TO AN ASPHALT PARKING LOT AND FLOWED ACROSS THE PARKING LOT TO A WOODED AREA AND SURFACE WATER STREAM. THE TRACTOR TRAILER/TANKER THEN PROCEEDED N ON US RT 17 TO THE VDOT COMMUTER PARKING LOT AND ADDITIONAL OIL WAS SPILLED TO THE PARKING LOT AREA AND ONTO THE GROUND AND A WET SWALE ALONG THE PERIMETER OF THE PARKING LOT. THE TRACTOR TRAILER TANKER DEPARTED THE SCENE. THE RP IS UNKNOWN. VIRGINIA DEQ IS REMEDIATING THE SPILL UNDER A STATE LEAD CONTRACTOR.

CALLER STATED THE GENERATOR THAT WAS BEING USED AT THE SCHOOL WAS LEAKING ABOUT 1 GALLON A WEEK FOR 2 TO 15 YEARS ONTO THE GROUND AND POSSIBLE SOAKING INTO NAZON BAY. IN ADDITION, THE SCHOOL ADDED ABOVE GROUND STORAGE TANKS TO REPLACE THE UNDERGROUND STORAGE TANKS THAT WERE LEAKING, BUT THE UNDERGROUND TANKS WERE NEVER DISCONNECTED AND ARE STILL TIED TO THE ABOVE GROUND TANKS. SO THE UNDERGROUND TANKS STILL HAVE OIL RUNNING THROUGH THEM AND THE TANKS ARE LEAKING INTO THE GROUND SUBSURFACE. THE SCHOOL ALSO HAS SOME HOUSING THAT IS CONNECTED TO THE GENERATOR AND STORAGE TANKS AS WELL AND THE PIPING THAT GOES TO THE HOUSE TO PROVIDE THE OIL IS ALSO LEAKING INTO THE GROUND. CALLER ESTIMATES THE LEAK RATE ON THAT PIPING IS AT LEAST 7 GALLONS A MONTH OVER A LONG PERIOD OF TIME. CALLER HAS PHOTOS AND VIDEO TO PROVIDE IF NEEDED. CALLER STATED THIS WAS INITIALLY REPORTED TO THE DEP AND THEY HAVEN"T TAKEN ANY ACTION TO CLEAN UP OR MITIGATE THE ISSUES. CALLER STATED THE LEAKING GENERATOR HAS BEEN ADDRESSED AND STOPPED, BUT THE SPILLS FROM THE GENERATOR WERE NEVER CLEANED UP.
